model: Claude Code agent mode, fresh subagent

definitions.meaning: includes a long bow, recurve bow, composite bow, or crossbow
definitions.quote: Bow includes a long bow, recurve bow, composite bow, or crossbow.

definitions.meaning: includes any barreled weapon using a propellant, compressed air, explosives, or gas from which any shot, bullet, or other projectile can be discharged but does not include starting pistols when used in connection with an athletic or sporting event where blank ammunition is used, or paintball guns when used in a licensed and insured facility designed for organized paintball games
definitions.quote: Firearm includes any barreled weapon using a propellant, compressed air, explosives, or gas from which any shot, bullet, or other projectile can be discharged but does not include: (a) Starting pistols when used in connection with an athletic or sporting event where blank ammunition is used; (b) paintball guns when used in a licensed and insured facility designed for organized paintball games.
City means the City of Langley.

prohibitions.quote: No person shall discharge a firearm or bow within the City.

exceptions.quote: (1) a peace officer, a conservation officer under the Wildlife Act, an enforcement officer of the Department of Fisheries and Oceans, an employee of the Canadian Wildlife service, or a person appointed to enforce the City’s Animal Control Bylaw, when engaged in the lawful performance of their duties;

(2) land located in the Agricultural Land Reserve where a firearm or bow is discharged for the purpose of: (a) the protection of agricultural crops, livestock, or domestic animals from wildlife; or (b) the humane destruction of livestock.

quotes.quote: This bylaw shall be cited as the “Firearms Regulation Bylaw, 2015, No. 2961”.
FINALLY ADOPTED this thirteenth day of July, 2015.
No person shall discharge a firearm or bow within the City.
